items.title: Accelerating discovery with the AI for Math Initiative
items.summary: The initiative brings together some of the world's most prestigious research institutions to pioneer the use of AI in mathematical research.
items.summaryZh: 谷歌及其旗下Google DeepMind联合五家顶尖研究机构正式推出“AI数学倡议”，旨在通过人工智能加速基础数学研究与科学突破。该项目依托Gemini Deep Think与AlphaEvolve等先进模型技术，由谷歌提供资金与算力支持，帮助数学家解决复杂的科学难题，探索AI与数学交叉领域的前沿创新。

items.title: Introducing gpt-oss-safeguard
items.summary: OpenAI introduces gpt-oss-safeguard—open-weight reasoning models for safety classification that let developers apply and iterate on custom policies.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI正式发布了名为gpt-oss-safeguard的开放权重推理模型，专门用于安全分类与合规审查。该模型允许开发者针对自定义安全策略进行灵活配置与快速迭代，提升AI应用的安全防护水平。这是OpenAI在开源安全工具领域的重要动作，为企业与开发者提供了更具可控性的安全审核解决方案。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI推出gpt-oss-safeguard开放权重模型，为开发者自定义AI安全分类与合规审查提供了有效工具。

items.title: gpt-oss-safeguard technical report
items.summary: gpt-oss-safeguard-120b and gpt-oss-safeguard-20b are two open-weight reasoning models post-trained from the gpt-oss models and trained to reason from a provided policy in order to label content under that policy. In this report, we describe gpt-oss-safeguard’s capabilities and provide our baseline safety evaluations on the gpt-oss-safeguard models, using the underlying gpt-oss models as a baseline.
